displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 7 red flashes
meaning: The flame could not be established during three trials for ignition. The furnace locks out for one hour and then restarts.
causes: Gas valve switch not in the ON position
Loose wires or a burner problem
diySteps: Check that the switch on the gas valve is in the ON position, and that other gas appliances in the home still light
Technician: check gas pressure, the gas valve, the flame sensor, the hot surface ignitor, wiring and the burners
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the gas valve switch is ON and 7 red flashes return after the one-hour lockout.
